Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBugTrigger' calls 'showBug' method with an instance of 'MyClass'. Inside 'showBug', the method 'assertEqualToItself' is invoked which contains the bug where the object is compared to itself using 'Objects.equals'. This comparison is always true hence the 'assertFalse' in the test will fail, triggering the bug.
